strings.name: Jennifer Lopez
strings.summary: Raised in a Puerto Rican family in New York, Lopez entered television and film through dance. Selena established her acting profile and On the 6 launched her recording career. She continues across musical stages, romantic comedy and drama; Hustlers and Kiss of the Spider Woman reflect varied screen choices and greater visibility for Latina performers.
